_format: Each case: attacker, move, defender, optional opts (same names as calc.py flags with underscores: atk_nature, atk_sp, def_nature, def_sp, boost, def_boost, crit, spread, burn, weather, item, ability, def_ability, def_item, helping_hand, terrain, screen, doubles, hits), and expected min/max damage in HP. Use expected_pct [min, max] instead if you only know the % of the defender's HP (the game shows %). source says where the number came from: in-game, calculator, or hand. Set skip: true to park a case. 'rolls' (optional) is the full sorted list of 16 damage rolls and is compared exactly.
